name: nation-design-system
description: Nation Group Thailand Design System token pipeline

scripts.tokens:build: node scripts/clean-selfref.mjs && node scripts/generate-scale.mjs && node scripts/build-tokens.mjs
scripts.tokens:sync: npm run tokens:pull && npm run tokens:build
scripts.worklog: npm run worklog:new && npm run worklog:asana
scripts.worklog:schedule-on: launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.nation.worklog-remind.plist && echo '✓ เตือน worklog เปิด (จ-ศ 16:00)'
scripts.worklog:schedule-off: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.nation.worklog-remind.plist && echo '✓ เตือน worklog ปิดแล้ว'
scripts.worklog:month-on: launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.nation.worklog-month.plist && echo '✓ push worklog อัตโนมัติ เปิด (จ-ศ 16:30)'
scripts.worklog:month-off: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.nation.worklog-month.plist && echo '✓ push worklog อัตโนมัติ ปิดแล้ว'
